reviews.comment: I enjoyed professor Lamberts class and learned a lot! Her lectures are interesting, and she gives extra credit for attending class (free points). She cares a lot about her students, and her office hours were extremely helpful! Would highly recommend this professor! Very achievable to get an A if you put in effort.
Her class was boring so I stopped attending after a week. If you read the textbook, look over the slides and do practice problems it isn't so hard.

When I took this class it was professor Lambert's first time teaching it, while it did start off bad especially Exam 1 she did correct herself and improved throughout the semester. She is very fair and while I do not like how she password protects her slides, she does offer 5% of your overall grade as extra credit for attending her lectures.

reviews.comment: Could not even tell you what I learned in this class. Hopefully your TA is good if you take her because she truly has no idea what she is doing. During class she had students helping her do the notes because she didnt know how to do the work on her slides. If you have a choice don't take her class.
